metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the CLI IGES tool in [`output/main.js`](/workspace/output/main.js) with supporting modules in `output/`. It supports `parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, and `roundtrip`, uses only the Node.js standard library, emits the required diagnostic envelope on failures, writes fixed-format 80-column IGES output, parses/writes the canonical JSON model, validates the required Global/DE rules, and includes evaluators for the contract’s supported curve/surface families.

I also ran local smoke checks for `write`, `parse`, `eval`, and `roundtrip` on generated fixtures, including a byte-identical second roundtrip on a written IGES file. The main files are [`output/iges.js`](/workspace/output/iges.js), [`output/schema.js`](/workspace/output/schema.js), and [`output/evaluator.js`](/workspace/output/evaluator.js).
